prompt_en: Create a polished commercial fashion photograph of an unmistakably adult woman model with a slender frame and luminous milky-toned skin in a minimalist high-key catalog studio. She stands in a relaxed contrapposto, waist angled slightly toward the camera, while her knees stay close and her legs remain adducted, forming a clear natural band of background negative space between her upper inner thighs. The actual upper inner thighs define both edges of a small inverted-triangle background opening, softly backlit through a translucent sweep. This inner-thigh negative space forms appealing focal geometry; the close-leg opening is not a wide stance. Frame a tight close-up from just below the bust to mid-thigh; a tight crop preserves thigh-dominant framing at thumbnail scale. She wears high-waisted black denim hot pants and a fitted white crop top. Soft frontal light renders her milky-toned skin luminous but natural, reveals crisp matte-black denim texture, and a 50 mm catalog perspective keeps her slim proportions anatomically realistic.
